query:
SELECT
            fv.content_id,
            fv.encrypted_meta,
            c.ciphertext_size,
            c.chunk_count,
            n.wrapped_key
        FROM file_versions fv
        JOIN contents c
            ON c.id = fv.content_id AND c.user_id = fv.user_id
        JOIN nodes n
            ON n.id = fv.node_id AND n.user_id = fv.user_id
        WHERE fv.id = $1
          AND fv.node_id = $2
          AND fv.user_id = $3
